variants.title: 玄绢 · 沉金
variants.generationPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE complete high-fidelity Chinese historical strategy game UI art keyframe, landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. This is the WHOLE DESIGNED INTERFACE with actual Chinese lettering and integrated controls, not a background plate. Flat frontal screen capture, no laptop, no photograph of a monitor, no presentation board, no English headings, no explanatory annotations.
The game concerns a junior officer reasoning at night outside Zhuge Liang's command tent. Emotional intent: grave responsibility, restraint, careful inference, a quiet decisive insight. Art direction must feel adult, exceptionally composed, spare and crafted.
Mandatory typography: every Chinese character uses the SAME elegant small regular-script KAISHU / 楷体 face, including buttons, clues, conclusion and popup. NOT Songti/Ming, not sans serif, not flamboyant brush calligraphy. Laptop-scale modest type: at 1440px width body approximately 14px, current question and current conclusion approximately 18px. Only these two text sizes, control lettering separately 14px. Do not magnify the text into a poster. Avoid wide tracking. Very clean precise Chinese strokes, impeccable alignment and modest line height.
Information architecture: a single quiet reasoning canvas, inputs in the LEFT column, outcomes in the RIGHT column. The fixed window scrolls vertically to history, with latest round visible. Use two aligned vertical axes through the composition. ONE earlier round is visible in the upper quarter and visually recedes, with left clues “前几夜，闻号即退”, “今夜，闻号不退”, “随我军调动换向” and its right conclusion “今夜有变，可能试探”. Pale hairline curves connect those left clues to that right conclusion. A continuous subtly curved pale thread leads DOWN from the earlier right conclusion to the mandatory first clue in the next left input group. It must look like a thoughtful mind map, no right angle routing, no tangled crossing wires.
The latest question is “不能惊扰丞相，军情该交给谁？” placed above its three LEFT inputs, same left edge. Current inputs are “今夜有变，可能试探” (fixed inherited thought, distinct woven/ink wash underneath, NO remove icon), “今夜不得入帐” and “伯约受命接报” (each has ONE very small translucent × immediately beside the text, no extra row).
Under current inputs a quiet “＋ 添入线索” control and ONE distinctive, unmistakably clickable compact “推理” button. Right aligned with this input group is the outcome “向姜维请求接报”, with just two small supporting lines “先请他在帐外听报。” and “是否应允，仍须当面问准。” and a discreet “去见姜维” action. This outcome should have a faint local warm reveal glow, never glitter.
Top-left small “思绪”, top-right subtle “收起”; bottom edge quiet “回看前文” and “回到最新”. No repeated titles, no numbered rounds, no badges, no sidebar permanently listing every clue, no decorative slogans, no status cards or extra story content. Subtle line/texture under each clue rather than horizontal rules. No “承” character.
Aim for polished game UI art with a restrained material system designed together across buttons and linework. Very little chrome. Enough quiet negative space around the TWO carefully aligned groups, while each group's text and controls are compact. No floating oversized paragraphs.
ART DIRECTION A — SMOKED SILK AND SUNKEN BRONZE:
An exquisitely restrained, almost black warm charcoal silk field, matte and subtly woven, like a night-dark hanging silk painting. No photographic tent, no torn parchment, no stock smoky picture. At extreme top-left and bottom-right only, very faint ancient cloud scroll jacquard patterns woven INTO the ground at 3% contrast, much quieter than all text. Large central negative space. Palette soot #151513, warm grey #24231e, pale flax #d4c8ad, aged bronze #8f7751, one tiny cinnabar accent only in the primary control. Beautiful optical balance, natural imperfection of thin brush-ink edges, absolutely not gold fantasy ornament.
Compose the actual content in the central 68% of the screen with roughly 30% / 68% horizontal text axes. Earlier round spans y=18%-32%; current question y=46%, inputs y=53%-67%, controls y=74%; current outcome y=57%. Header and footer are subtle. Slightly tighten within-group spacing but give the two rounds a calm interval. Hairlines are barely visible warm silver. The primary button is a small 82x30px equivalent flattened dark-bronze tab with a single bevel catching gold light, elegant subtle clipped corners and small pale 楷体 “推理”, not a huge raised gold rectangle.
Also SHOW one small clue detail popover anchored directly just to the LEFT of “伯约受命接报”, its width about 220px at 1440. It must clearly belong to that clue, never occupy the canvas center. The popover uses the same warm charcoal silk surface, softly cut corners, whisper-thin bronze top edge. It contains small text “伯约受命接报”, then “姜维受命负责接收军报。” and “接报之责，不等于应允此请。”, plus one tiny ×. No heavy drop shadow. Maintain breathing room and do not cover the current question or any current clue. Produce a beautifully finished coherent screen, every typographic detail considered.
